Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients met diagnostic criteria for schizophrenia  [OR] or schizoaffective disorder using the Structural Clinical Interview for Diagnostic and Statistical Manual Diploma in Social Medicine (DSM)-IV (SCID, Version 2

right.raw_text: -  Patients remain their psychotropic medication at steady dosages for at least 4 weeks prior to study entry and for the duration of the trial

left.raw_text: -  Verbal intelligence quotient > 85 as measured by using a Chinese version of the National Adult Reading Test

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  History of significant head trauma  [OR] or neurological disorders
  -  Alcohol  [OR] or drug abuse Focal brain lesions on T1- [OR]  or T2-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion-recovery magnetic resonance images
  -  a prior history of a seizure not induced by drug withdrawal,first degree relative with epilepsy, significant neurological illness  [OR] or head trauma, [OR]  endocrine disease, such as thyroid disease, significant unstable medical condition, recent aggression  [OR] or other forms of behavioral dyscontrol
  -  left-handedness, [OR]  pregnancy
  -  estimated intelligence quotient<80
  -  current alcohol  [OR] or drug abuse
  -  inability to provide informed consent

right.raw_text: -  Hamilton Anxiety Rating Scale  [OR] or the Hamilton Depression Rating Scale score > 10
